text:
incident-bot: [P1] Cache eviction spike detected in prefix cache (region: us-west). Error rate up for generation routes; some requests returning stale fallback path.
oncall-backend: I'm on it, paging. Seeing eviction metric jump at +250% around 16:10 UTC. Root cause unclear yet.
sre-lead: TL;DR: eviction storms are causing KV lookups to timeout, fallback path hits origin and sometimes returns inconsistent tokenization. We should force a safe bypass for correctness and apply a temporary circuit-breaker to limit origin QPS.
oncall-backend: Agreed. Plan: 1) flip circuit breaker to safe_bypass mode 2) apply per-tenant soft rate limit 3) enable verbose logs for evictions. I'll run commands.
eng-runtime: FYI, toggling bypass will increase per-token CPU but keeps correctness. Use this command on prod-control: ```prod-control set cache.circuit_breaker.eviction_mode bypass --reason "correctness fallback"``` 
oncall-backend: running now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: config change detected by oncall-backend — cache.circuit_breaker.eviction_mode=bypass
support-ic: Do we have a list of impacted customers so we can pre-emptively message CS? Saw increased 5xx for two customers on gen API.
sre-lead: quick query: `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE route LIKE '%/v1/generate%' AND status>=500 GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;` returns tenant_42 and tenant_acme at top.
oncall-frontend: re: comms — sending brief to support: "We're applying emergency cache bypass to prevent incorrect outputs. Traffic may slow for heavy gen requests. We'll update in 30m." :loudspeaker: 
eng-runtime: Applying rate cap for heavy tenants: ```ratectl limit tenant_42 60rps tenant_acme 40rps --window 60s --reason "eviction spill mitigation"``` — applied.
oncall-backend: Circuit breaker flipped to bypass; eviction write throughput back to baseline in metrics. Origin error rate down ~70% for impacted routes.
sre-lead: Keep verbose eviction logs on for 30m and watch mem pressure. If mem climbs >80% for serving nodes we may need to roll back bypass and instead shed low-priority traffic.
oncall-backend: Noted. Handoff to next oncall in 25m: @oncall-frontend is now covering. Leaving monitoring alerts and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-storm
oncall-frontend: Ack and taking over. Will coordinate with support for customer notes and capture timeline for postmortem.
support-ic: Customer comms sent to tenant_acme and tenant_42. Both acknowledged and appreciate the heads up.
eng-runtime: Quick post-change check: latency p50 for gen routes increased ~15ms but 95th dropped. Looks acceptable.
sre-lead: Good. Let's plan a short postmortem: owner @sre-lead, timeline capture by @oncall-backend, root cause triage with eng-runtime. We'll close thread when all notes posted.
oncall-backend: Closing my shift, handing off to @oncall-frontend. If anything spikes, call pager.
incident-bot: incident resolved: mitigation in place. Severity: degraded -> monitoring. Remember to file postmortem within 48h. :white_check_mark:
